311.incipit_english: Unto the Lord Who by His divine decree dried up the surging, impassable sea, and guided the people of Israel dry-shod through it, let us sing: for He is gloriously magnified.

313.incipit_english: Thou hast magnified, O Christ, the Mother of God who bore Thee, from whom our Creator clothed Himself in a body like unto ours to loose our transgressions: Blessing her, all generations do magnify.

314.incipit_reconstructed: Слѧцы́тесѧ, лю́дїе, сокрꙋши́вшемꙋ бра̑ни, и҆ ѻ҆троча̀ бж҃е́ственнѣ ѡ҆роси́вшемꙋ въ пещѝ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, да благослови́тъ всѧ́ка тва́рь гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
314.incipit_english: Bow down, ye peoples, before Him Who shattered wars and divinely dew-cooled the children in the furnace, Christ our God: let all creation bless the Lord and exalt Him above all forever.

315.incipit_english: Passing by the tree of knowledge in Eden of old, he came to the tree of the Cross, and reaping death through disobedience, we magnify the pure Mother of God who held God within her womb.

315.incipit_english: Strengthen me in distress of temptations, O Christ, upon the rock of Thy faith, and enlighten my mind to praise Thine exalted humility, O our God, and save me.

316.incipit_english: Since the furnace ignited sevenfold of old exceeded the tyrant's decree, wherein the youths were not burned, trampling underfoot the king's commandment, but cried out: All ye works of the Lord, praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever.

317.incipit_english: With pure souls and unblemished lips come, let us magnify the undefiled and most pure Mother of Christ, for she prayeth to her Son and our God to spare our souls.

319.incipit_english: By a stroke the Red Sea is cleft, and the wave-bearing abyss is dried up, becoming at once a traversed path to the unarmed and a tomb to the fully armed: while a divinely beautiful song was sung: For Christ our God is gloriously magnified.

320.incipit_english: Being the Lord and Creator of all, God united passion-frail creation unto Himself in poverty, and the Pascha, for which He was about to die, He Himself prefigured: Eat, He cried, My Body, and be established in the faith.

321.incipit_english: Foreseeing Thy mystery ineffable, O Christ, the Prophet cried aloud: Thou hast set a steadfast love of strength, O merciful Father; for Thou, O Good One, hast sent Thine Only-begotten Son into the world as a cleansing sacrifice.

322.incipit_english: Bound by the bond of love, the Apostles, having dedicated themselves to Christ Who ruleth over all, had their beautiful feet cleansed, preaching peace unto all.

323.incipit_english: The lowest abyss of sins hath compassed me, and unable to endure the tempest, like Jonah I cry to Thee, O Master: Bring me up from corruption.

324.incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтроци во Вавилонѣ пещи пламени та не убояша ся
324.incipit_reconstructed: Ѻ҆́троцы въ вавѷлѡ́нѣ пещна́гѡ пла́мене не оу҆боя́шася, но посредѣ̀ пла́мене вве́ржени, ѡ҆роша́еми поя́хꙋ: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ, гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
324.incipit_english: The Children in Babylon feared not the furnace's flame, but cast into the midst of the fire, bedewed they sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.
